project: NER-SAFE Landslide Early Warning & Risk Monitoring System
component: Component 9: Spatial Alignment & Master Feature Grid

baseline_observation_window.season_context: Post-monsoon to dry winter pre-monsoon baseline

gpm_imerg_precipitation.source: NASA GPM IMERG Final Daily Precipitation (3B-DAY)
gpm_imerg_precipitation.scientific_safeguard: Original native ~10km products are strictly preserved. Resampled 30m layers represent spatially aligned continuous representations for regional model grid fusion; they do NOT constitute native 10m/30m rain gauge measurements.

smap_soil_moisture.source: NASA SMAP L3 Enhanced Radiometer Volumetric Soil Moisture (L3_SM_P_E)
smap_soil_moisture.outage_provenance: Documented NASA satellite payload safe hold / orbit anomaly
smap_soil_moisture.outage_handling: STRICTLY UNFABRICATED. Zero interpolation, duplication, or synthesis performed. A dedicated quality missing-data flag is explicitly retained.
smap_soil_moisture.resampling_method: Bilinear continuous (mean, max, min, std) / Nearest-Neighbor (valid count, outage flag)
smap_soil_moisture.scientific_safeguard: Original native ~9km products in EPSG:6933 are strictly preserved. Aligned 30m rasters represent spatially aligned representations for multi-factor modeling; they do NOT constitute native 30m soil sensor observations.

sentinel2_l2a.native_spatial_resolution: 10.0 meters (B02, B03, B04, B08) / 20.0 meters (B11, B12, SCL)

ground_truth_and_data_leakage_safeguard.inventory_source: Standardized Ground-Truth Inventory (NASA GLC, GSI NLSM, ISRO Bhuvan)
ground_truth_and_data_leakage_safeguard.data_leakage_prevention_protocol: Historical landslide event dates and spatial coordinates serve strictly as binary ground-truth target labels for supervised model training and spatial cross-validation. Historical landslide presence is NEVER used as an input predictor to forecast the same event or contemporaneous hazard, eliminating autocorrelation and data leakage.
